meta.name: api-designer
meta.description: Use when designing REST or GraphQL APIs, creating OpenAPI specifications, or planning API architecture. Invoke for resource modeling, versioning strategies, pagination patterns, error handling standards.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计 REST 或 GraphQL 接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或规划 API 架构
copy.tagline_en: Design REST or GraphQL API specifications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or plan API architecture

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成资深 API 设计师，帮你设计 REST 或 GraphQL 接口、编写 OpenAPI 规范、规划资源模型、版本策略、分页方式和错误处理标准。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计 API”、“REST 接口”、“OpenAPI 规范”等关键词，或要求进行资源建模、版本规划时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户管理的 REST API。
say.note: Claude 会输出资源模型、端点、OpenAPI 规范等。

say.text: 为我的博客系统写一个 GraphQL schema。
say.note: Claude 会生成 GraphQL 类型定义和查询/变更。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a senior API designer, helping you design REST or GraphQL APIs, create OpenAPI specifications, model resources, plan versioning, pagination, and error handling.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'API design', 'REST API', 'OpenAPI specification', or ask for resource modeling, versioning strategy, etc.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for user management.
say_en.note: Claude will output resource model, endpoints, OpenAPI spec, etc.

say_en.text: Write a GraphQL schema for my blog system.
say_en.note: Claude will generate GraphQL type definitions and queries/mutations.
